statement: For real M,H>=1 and integers u,v with (u,v) nonzero and abs(u),abs(v)<=H, put f(x)=(u/2)*(1+2*M*x)^(9/2)+(v/(2*M))*(1+2*M*x)^(9/4) and e(y)=exp(2*pi*i*y). For every real P>=max(H^2,6), norm(sum_(P<n<=2P) e(f(n)))<=32*H^(1/30)*M^(1/4)*P^(59/60). For every integer T>=1 with H<=T^(1/4), norm(sum_(0<=t<T) e(f(t)))/T<=128*M^(1/4)*H^(1/30)*T^(-1/60). Both frequency axes, signs, real dyadic endpoints and small T are included. This is the uniform quantitative Fourier input Q2 of the effective OOE theorem, not its counting or witness conclusion.
